description: Main application component for the mobile Ludo game, including UI layout, game state management, and interactions such as starting a new game, restoring saved games, rolling dice, and making moves.

methods.name: randomDice
methods.description: Generates a random dice value between 1 and 6.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Initializes a new game with selected players and updates the game state.

methods.name: resetToSetup
methods.description: Resets the game to the player setup screen, with confirmation dialog.

methods.name: onRollDice
methods.description: Handles the dice roll action, providing feedback and updating game state after delay.

methods.name: onSelectMove
methods.description: Processes a player's move, updating game state, playing feedback sounds, and advancing turn.

methods.name: togglePlayer
methods.description: Toggles the active status of a player.

methods.name: restoreSaved
methods.description: Restores a saved game from storage.
